changelog:
- Initial release of the sanitize skill.
- Detects and redacts 15 categories of PII from text files, including credit cards, SSNs, email addresses, API keys, and more.
- No external dependencies; works using only the Python standard library.
- Enforces strict PII safety rules: never read raw input or entity map files; only view sanitized output.
- Supports output to file, category filtering, preview, and JSON modes (all designed to avoid exposing raw PII).
- All processing is done locally, ensuring no PII leaves your machine.
summary: Detect and redact PII from text files. Supports 15 categories including credit cards, SSNs, emails, API keys, addresses, and more — with zero dependencies.
